messages:
incident-bot: PAGED #oncall (sev2) - 502/conn-reset spike observed in apac2b across ALB fronting envoy (service: inference-gateway). Automated healthchecks flagged ~30% of ALB targets unhealthy.

alice.m: seeing a big spike in 502 + ECONNRESET in logs, started ~2026-03-15T03:20Z, traffic ~apac2b only. Customers reporting errors on streaming responses.

bob.l: thanks - pulling healthcheck logs now, any obvious deploys?

chris.g: no deploys in apac2b in last hour. ALB health checks show timeout errors to envoy on port 8080, but envoys themselves look healthy on host-level.

alice.m: repro steps: curl to ALB => intermittent 502, direct curl to envoy node IP: returns 200. looks like ALB->envoy TLS/keepalive flapping.

dana.k: ok, moving to mitigation steps: 1) remove ALB keepalive (set proxy protocol idle timeout) 2) shift small % of traffic to eu-west as temporary fallback 3) bring up spare NLB in apac2b and attach envoy podset.

mark.s: I can do the Route53 weight change. Recommend 20% weighted shift off apac2b to eu-west while we investigate.

evie.ops: I'm standing by to run the NLB attach and change service annotation. Runbook snippet:
```bash
# create nlb target group and attach service
kubectl apply -f nlb-ingress-annotation.yaml
# scaledown rollout for ALB listeners
aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn $ARN --default-actions Type=fixed-response --region apac2
```

bob.l: trying to repro ALB connection reset with tcpdump on envoy host - saw lots of FIN, keepalive race. Kernel show: net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time spikes and ALB dropping conn.

alice.m: temporarily increased idle timeout on ALB from 60s -> 120s as a quick mitigation to reduce resets. Monitoring for error rate.

incident-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty incident #INC-4521 created, oncall alice.m (primary) / chris.g (secondary).

chris.g: NLB attach started, patched service annotation, new NLB endpoints registering. Route53 shift 20% executed by mark.s.

mark.s: Route53 update done: apac2b weight -> 80, eu-west -> 20. TTL 30s.

evie.ops: new NLB healthy, traffic draining from ALB targets. Error rate dropped from 28% -> 6% within 2 minutes.

alice.m: collecting artifacts for postmortem: ALB's keepalive behavior + envoy idle handling mismatch. Need to capture ALB listener metrics, keepalive settings, envoy socket stats.

bob.l: log snippet from envoy (conn reset):
```
[2026-03-15T03:22:14Z] envoy error: connection reset by peer id=0x7f2 source=10.0.3.45:8080 target=10.0.1.12:443
```

dana.k: customer impact: internal metrics show ~1200 requests failed over 15m, mainly streaming sessions timed out. Two paying customers reported degraded UX. Ops notified account owners.

chris.g: next steps: 1) replace ALB with NLB for that service in apac2b (short term), 2) add keepalive alignment tests in staging, 3) add an alert for ALB target health flapping tied to conn-reset signature.

alice.m: handing off to chris.g for overnight watch and postmortem writeup. chris.g take over oncall? @chris.g

chris.g: taking handoff at 03:40Z. I'll coordinate postmortem and assign action items.

alice.m: thanks everyone, incident downgraded to monitoring. Will update PD notes and close once postmortem posted. :white_check_mark:
